## Which plane?

Every feature must belong clearly to exactly one (spec §83):

- [ ] Control plane
- [ ] Content Storage Fabric
- [ ] Personal state plane
- [ ] External specialist integration
- [ ] None of the above (tooling, docs, CI)

## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint test` passes
- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour (not just the happy path)
- [ ] An ADR was added or updated if this changes an architectural stance
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) — see CONTRIBUTING.md
